title: Built through curiosity. Driven by engineering.
sub: Six years of building production software, taking ownership of products, and solving complex engineering challenges.
paragraphs: I'm a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer and former Founding Engineer & Tech Lead with 6 years of experience architecting and building production systems across multiple domains, including Fintech, HR-Tech, and Marketplace platforms. I've worked with teams at different stages of growth, from early-stage startups to large enterprises, contributing to products from initial concepts through production.

My technical experience spans the full stack, from backend architecture, API design, distributed systems, and data-intensive applications to complex frontend applications, interactive experiences, and real-time interfaces. I work primarily with the JavaScript and TypeScript ecosystems, alongside relational and NoSQL databases, cloud infrastructure, and modern web technologies

I began my career working independently, building applications and collaborating with clients across 20+ countries. Working across different products and industries gave me broad exposure to software development, from translating requirements into technical solutions to delivering complete, production-ready applications. It also taught me to adapt quickly, work autonomously, and take responsibility for the things I build.

Over time, my work evolved from independent product development to technical leadership and enterprise engineering. As a Founding Engineer & Tech Lead at BorrowBe, I led a team of three and owned much of the architecture and development of a two-sided marketplace. At Moback, I worked on core backend services powering Korn Ferry Talent Suite, including service routing, streaming exports, and request tracing. Most recently, at NymCard, I developed features for Nym4Business, a multi-tenant B2B financial platform.

I'm interested in understanding software beyond its abstractions. I enjoy investigating how systems behave internally, identifying performance bottlenecks, and understanding the trade-offs behind architectural decisions. This curiosity extends into the details of the technologies I work with, from distributed systems and database internals to graphics programming and numerical simulation. It shapes how I approach unfamiliar problems and build systems that are easier to reason about, maintain, and improve.
